entry.title: Welcome to the New MarCEL Website
entry.summary: We're excited to launch our new website showcasing our marine conservation research.
entry.content:
We're delighted to launch our new website for the Marine Conservation Ecology Lab!

What You'll Find Here

Our new website provides:

  • Research Updates: Stay informed about our latest discoveries and ongoing projects
  • Publications: Access our growing collection of peer-reviewed research papers
  • Team Profiles: Meet the researchers driving our marine conservation efforts
  • Collaboration Opportunities: Learn how you can work with us

Our Focus

MarCEL continues to lead innovative research on marine conservation ecology, with particular emphasis on:

  • Sea turtle migration and conservation
  • Fish spatial ecology
  • Marine Protected Area design

Get Involved

Stay tuned for more updates on our research breakthroughs and conservation successes.
